title: Decoding work-cell indices
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state binary Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $N,T,t\in\mathbb N$, and let $\tau$ be a work tape. For every offset $r<2T+1$, the tableau index assigned to time $t$, tape $\tau$, and offset $r$ decodes as the work-cell position $(t,\tau,r)$.
